    <div class="btns">
      <a class="btn btn-emerald" href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_ID" target="_blank">📂 Open Data Lake CSV in Google Drive</a>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="dlJson()">⬇️ Download Full Untouched Data Lake JSON</button>
      <button class="btn btn-amber" onclick="dlCsv()">⬇️ Download Full Untouched Data Lake CSV</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <label style="font-weight:700;">Source:</label>
    <select id="srcSel" onchange="render()">
      <option value="ALL">All Sources (${fullLake.length} Untouched Records)</option>
      <option value="1. Google Trends">1. Google Trends (All Categories + Apparel Cat 68 — 20 Rows)</option>
      <option value="2. Google Shopping">2. Google Shopping (15 Rows)</option>
      <option value="3. Amazon">3. Amazon Marketplace (Scrapling Default — 15 Rows)</option>
      <option value="4. Walmart">4. Walmart Marketplace (15 Rows)</option>
      <option value="5. Pinterest">5. Pinterest Trends & Ideas (20 Rows)</option>
      <option value="6. Etsy">6. Etsy Marketplace (10 Rows)</option>
      <option value="7. Redbubble">7. Redbubble / Zazzle POD (Scrapling Default — 10 Rows)</option>
      <option value="8. Same-Niche D2C">8. Same-Niche D2C Shopify /products.json (18 Full Product Objects)</option>
      <option value="9. Printify">9. Printify Master Catalog Blueprints (20 Rows)</option>
    </select>
    <label style="font-weight:700;">Region Cluster:</label>
    <select id="regSel" onchange="render()">
      <option value="ALL">All 3 Target Regions (US-Canada, Europe, Australia-NZ)</option>
      <option value="US-Canada">US-Canada (US, CA)</option>
      <option value="Europe">Europe (UK, DE)</option>
      <option value="Australia-New Zealand">Australia-New Zealand (AU, NZ)</option>
    </select>
    <input id="qBox" placeholder="Search inside any raw JSON field, tag, SKU, ASIN..." oninput="render()" style="min-width:260px;">
    <span id="statTxt" style="color:#38bdf8;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;"></span>
  </div>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:90px;">Lake ID</th>
        <th style="width:210px;">Source</th>
        <th style="width:150px;">Region & Locale</th>
        <th style="width:220px;">Record Title / Query</th>
        <th style="width:90px;">Raw Keys</th>
        <th>100% Untouched Raw JSON Payload (Every Field Preserved in Data Lake)</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody id="tb"></tbody>
  </table>
<script>
const LAKE = ${JSON.stringify(fullLake)};
const CSV_RAW = ${JSON.stringify(finalCsv)};
function render() {
  const s = document.getElementById('srcSel').value;
  const reg = document.getElementById('regSel').value;
  const q = document.getElementById('qBox').value.toLowerCase();
  const rows = LAKE.filter(r => {
    if (s !== 'ALL' && !r.source_name.includes(s)) return false;
    if (reg !== 'ALL' && r.region_cluster !== reg) return false;
    if (q && !JSON.stringify(r).toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  document.getElementById('statTxt').textContent = 'Showing ' + rows.length + ' of ' + LAKE.length + ' untouched Data Lake records';
  document.getElementById('tb').innerHTML = rows.map(r => \`
    <tr>
      <td style="font-family:monospace;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:700;">\${r.lake_id}</td>
      <td><span class="badge">\${r.source_name}</span></td>
      <td><span class="reg-badge">\${r.region_cluster} (\${r.locale})</span></td>
      <td style="font-weight:700;color:#fff;">\${r.record_title}</td>
      <td style="color:#fbbf24;font-weight:700;">\${r.field_count} fields</td>
      <td><pre>\${JSON.stringify(r.raw_payload, null, 2)}</pre></td>
    </tr>
  \`).join('');
}
function dlJson() {
  const b = new Blob([JSON.stringify(LAKE, null, 2)], {type:'application/json'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(b);
  a.download = 'raw_data_lake_all_sources_untouched_2026_10_15.json';
  a.click();
}
function dlCsv() {
  const b = new Blob([CSV_RAW], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(b);
  a.download = 'raw_data_lake_all_sources_untouched_2026_10_15.csv';
  a.click();
}
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>`;

return [{
  json: {
    status: "SUCCESS",
    total_lake_records: fullLake.length,
    htmlPage: htmlPage
  },
  binary: {
    data: binaryData
  }
}];

parameters.query:
-- ============================================================================
-- PRODUCTION DATA LAKE & MASTER WAREHOUSE SCHEMA (v5.0)
-- Target: Supabase PostgreSQL (ihjymibrnjyafrnjolue.supabase.co) & Cloud PG
-- Architecture:
--   Layer 1 (Bronze Data Lake): 8 Dedicated Raw Source Tables (100% Untouched)
--   Layer 2 (Gold Master Warehouse): 1 Unified Master Slicer & Statistical Table
--   Layer 3 (Commerce & AI Recs): Product Recommendations & Cross-Sell Matrix
-- ============================================================================

-- 0. Admin DDL Helper RPC (Allows service_role to run future schema migrations via REST)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.exec_sql(sql_query TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  EXECUTE sql_query;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'SUCCESS');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'ERROR', 'message', SQLERRM, 'sqlstate', SQLSTATE);
END;
$$;


-- ============================================================================
-- LAYER 1: 8 DEDICATED RAW SOURCE TABLES (BRONZE DATA LAKE — 0% DATA LOSS)
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Google Trends (All 20 Categories Trending Now + Apparel Cat 68 + 52w Curves)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_google_trends (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  discovery_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  query TEXT NOT NULL,
  search_volume BIGINT,
  increase_percentage INTEGER,
  categories_tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  trend_breakdown_tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  timeseries_52w JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  source_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_gt_locale ON public.raw_google_trends (region_cluster, locale);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_gt_payload ON public.raw_google_trends USING GIN (raw_payload);

-- 2. Google Shopping (Retail Prices, Merchants, Reviews, Delivery)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_google_shopping (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_id TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  price_raw TEXT,
  extracted_price NUMERIC(12,2),
  merchant_name TEXT,
  rating NUMERIC(4,2),
  reviews_count INTEGER,
  delivery_info TEXT,
  product_link TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_gshop_locale ON public.raw_google_shopping (region_cluster, locale);

-- 3. Amazon Marketplace (Scrapling Default: Movers & Shakers / Best Sellers)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_amazon_scrapling (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  asin TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  price_raw TEXT,
  extracted_price NUMERIC(12,2),
  bought_last_month TEXT,
  bsr_rank_change_pct INTEGER,
  rating NUMERIC(4,2),
  reviews_count INTEGER,
  badge TEXT,
  is_prime BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  product_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_amz_asin ON public.raw_amazon_scrapling (asin);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_amz_locale ON public.raw_amazon_scrapling (region_cluster, locale);

-- 4. Walmart Marketplace (Best Sellers & Trending Items)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_walmart (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  us_item_id TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  offer_price NUMERIC(12,2),
  was_price NUMERIC(12,2),
  currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',
  seller_name TEXT,
  rating NUMERIC(4,2),
  reviews_count INTEGER,
  product_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_wmt_locale ON public.raw_walmart (region_cluster, locale);

-- 5. Pinterest Trends & Ideas (API v5 & Direct /ideas/ Cluster Crawler)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_pinterest (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  cluster_or_pin_id TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  board_category TEXT,
  pin_saves_90d INTEGER,
  visual_tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  source_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_pin_locale ON public.raw_pinterest (region_cluster, locale);

-- 6. Etsy Marketplace (Open API v3 & Market Hubs)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_etsy (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  listing_or_hub_id TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  price NUMERIC(12,2),
  num_favorers INTEGER,
  views INTEGER,
  is_personalizable BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  snippet TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_etsy_locale ON public.raw_etsy (region_cluster, locale);

-- 7. Redbubble & Zazzle POD Tags (Scrapling Default)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_redbubble_zazzle (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Redbubble',
  tag_slug TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  merch_type TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(12,2),
  snippet TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_rb_locale ON public.raw_redbubble_zazzle (region_cluster, locale);

-- 8. Same-Niche D2C Websites (Shopify /products.json Direct Full Objects)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.raw_shopify_d2c (
  lake_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,
  store_domain TEXT NOT NULL,
  shopify_product_id BIGINT,
  handle TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  vendor TEXT,
  product_type TEXT,
  primary_sku TEXT,
  primary_price NUMERIC(12,2),
  available BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  variants_json JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  images_json JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  product_url TEXT,
  updated_at_source TIMESTAMPTZ,
  raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_d2c_locale ON public.raw_shopify_d2c (region_cluster, locale);

-- ============================================================================
-- LAYER 2: UNIFIED MASTER SLICER & STATISTICAL WAREHOUSE TABLE (GOLD LAYER)
-- Queried by Step 2 Slicer (<5ms) so Step 3 Statistics runs ONLY on filtered rows!
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.master_trends_warehouse (
  trend_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  topic TEXT NOT NULL,
  region_cluster TEXT NOT NULL,          -- Filter 1A: US-Canada | Europe | Australia-New Zealand
  locale TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- Filter 1B: US | CA | UK | DE | ES | AU | NZ
  place TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- Filter 2: Sub-Region / Metro / State
  trend_kind TEXT NOT NULL,              -- Filter 3: Festival/Macro | Evergreen Niche | Micro-Trend
  niche TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- Filter 4: Niche Vertical
  primary_source TEXT NOT NULL,          -- Filter 5: Primary Source Name
  sources_rising JSONB NOT NULL,         -- Array of all sources where this trend is rising
  platforms_rising_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- Filter 6: Multi-platform rise count
  demographics TEXT NOT NULL,            -- Filter 7: Target Persona
  age_bracket TEXT NOT NULL,             -- Filter 8: Age Bracket (18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45+)
  gender_skew TEXT NOT NULL,             -- Filter 9: Female | Male | Unisex
  time_window TEXT NOT NULL,             -- Filter 10: 7d | 30d | 90d (3M) | 12M
  search_volume BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
  velocity_pct NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  competitor_listings INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  avg_market_price NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
  ols_t_stat NUMERIC(8,3),
  ols_p_value NUMERIC(8,5),
  bayesian_win_prob_pct NUMERIC(6,2),
  monte_carlo_expected_profit NUMERIC(12,2),
  compliance_status TEXT DEFAULT 'APPROVED_SAFE',
  tags_and_buzzwords JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  recommended_printify_blueprints JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  source_lake_refs JSONB NOT NULL        -- Links back to exact lake_id rows in the 8 raw_* tables
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_master_slicer_composite
  ON public.master_trends_warehouse (region_cluster, locale, gender_skew, time_window, niche, trend_kind);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_master_slicer_tags
  ON public.master_trends_warehouse USING GIN (tags_and_buzzwords);

-- ============================================================================
-- LAYER 3: PRODUCT & PURCHASE RECOMMENDATIONS TABLE (Cross-Sell / Upsell Engine)
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.mw_product_recommendations (
  rec_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  brand_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  anchor_trend_id TEXT REFERENCES public.master_trends_warehouse(trend_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  anchor_blueprint_id INTEGER,
  recommended_blueprint_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  recommended_product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  recommendation_type TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 'FREQUENTLY_BOUGHT_TOGETHER' | 'COMPLETE_THE_LOOK' | 'PERSONALIZED_UPSELL'
  is_customizable BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  confidence_score NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.85,
  bundle_discount_pct NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 10.0,
  rationale TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mw_recs_anchor ON public.mw_product_recommendations (anchor_trend_id, brand_name);
